title: Aureline M5 imported / offline evidence state
description: Canonical per-domain state for imported / offline route evidence. Names the object class, its supported-line association, the imported / offline-evidence-only disclosure, the import context / provenance, the controlled restore-fidelity vocabulary, and any current live-route mismatch so imported route data never masquerades as current live route, service, or workspace truth. Downstream shell, support, help / docs, and companion / export surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's imported / offline state by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
